name: Paul Peter
headline: Full-stack engineer who ships web products that work
marquee: FULL-STACK WEB APPS, REAL-TIME FEATURES, AND DEPENDABLE BACKENDS
subtext: I build web apps and backend services with Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. I care about speed, clean data, and workflows people can use without thinking twice.

about.content:
I'm a full-stack engineer based in Lagos. I build web applications from the interface down to the database: responsive UIs in Next.js and TypeScript, real-time features over WebSockets, and data models in PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

I like code that stays readable, APIs that are documented, and apps that behave the same way every time. I work with clients and teams who want something that ships and keeps running.

hero.quote: Fast, dependable web apps built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
